mapper.select: SELECT bd_mgt_sn, ai_model_nm, total_score, flood_score, sink_score, fire_score, struct_score, total_brief, flood_brief, sink_brief, fire_brief, struct_brief FROM building_safety_report WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{bdMgtSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO building_safety_report (bd_mgt_sn, ai_model_nm, total_score, flood_score, sink_score, fire_score, struct_score) VALUES (#{bdMgtSn}, #{aiModelNm}, #{totalScore}, #{floodScore}, #{sinkScore}, #{fireScore}, #{structScore}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ai_model_nm = VALUES(ai_model_nm), total_score = VALUES(total_score), flood_score = VALUES(flood_score), sink_score = VALUES(sink_score), fire_score = VALUES(fire_score), struct_score = VALUES(struct_score), total_brief = NULL, flood_brief = NULL, sink_brief = NULL, fire_brief = NULL, struct_brief = NULL, total_report = NULL, flood_report = NULL, sink_report = NULL, fire_report = NULL, struct_report = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE building_safety_report SET ai_model_nm = #{aiModelNm}, total_brief = #{briefs.totalBrief}, flood_brief = #{briefs.floodBrief}, sink_brief = #{briefs.sinkBrief}, fire_brief = #{briefs.fireBrief}, struct_brief = #{briefs.structBrief} WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{bdMgtSn}
